subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own mirroring Control UI-originated turns into Open WebUI's visible history store, and if yes what supported API/config/backfill boundary should it use?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses from OpenClaw transcript/session state into third-party Open WebUI persistence, so automation cannot safely choose DB writes, supported API integration, plugin ownership, or historical backfill policy.

options.title: Opt-in core integration
options.body: Add an explicit, documented Open WebUI sync path only after live proof of the current schema/API contract, with focused tests and a repair/backfill story.

options.title: Plugin or ClawHub owner
options.body: Keep core as the OpenAI-compatible backend and move Open WebUI visible-history mirroring into a plugin or external integration that can track Open WebUI schema changes.

options.title: Decline visible-history mirroring
options.body: Document that OpenClaw transcript/context and Open WebUI visible history are separate stores unless Open WebUI calls OpenClaw through a supported session path.

recommendation.title: Opt-in core integration
recommendation.body: Add an explicit, documented Open WebUI sync path only after live proof of the current schema/API contract, with focused tests and a repair/backfill story.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across gateway chat.send and Open WebUI smoke coverage.
